description: Per-occurrence identifier value-category adjudication for the wire identifier properties whose resolved schema terminal constraint does NOT determine the category on its own. Occurrences the type system decides (an anchored ak:<kind>: / ak:did_core: / did: / ak.<symbol> terminal) are deliberately absent: copying an obvious $ref into a hand-kept table would create a second truth that drifts away from the schema. Rows are keyed by (property name, resolved terminal signature); a differently typed occurrence of the same name lands in a different row and fails closed.
